name: Orfeo
source:
The boss of a mafia faction that controls Asgard from the shadows. He has a tough appearance, but deep down, he has a heart of gold and is quite fond of children. 

While highly capable in combat, he is more of a black market mafioso.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3664240/Norns_Dine/]Steam[/url]]
